readme: ChatHeadEnabler =============== An Xposed module that lets you choose between chat head and bubble in Facebook Messenger (Android 11+) For non-rooted device: check this [thread](https://forum.xda-developers.com/t/4331215) Installation ------------ - Download and Install ChatHeadEnabler. - Active it from LSPosed Manager. - Restart Messenger. Features -------- By default, this module enables the chat head feature. In order to change it to bubble, - Open messenger app and go to its setting page. - Click on the toggle icon from the top-right corner. - Choose bubble option from the pop-up dialog. If you want to hide the toggle icon, long press on it and remove.
